primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文でこの人物または人物への明示的言及を確認。

review.identityCheckJa: 本文は王の母をエルシャ、父をツァドクと記します。ヨタム記事には母名の異形があり、記事の人物同定は補助的な関係にとどめます。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 常時表示は初出で分かる情報に限り、後続情報は初出節以後のfactsにゲート。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article’s infobox and lead identify Jotham as son of Uzziah and Jerusha daughter of Zadok; Kings 15:33 instead describes Jotham’s mother as daughter of Zadok, with a name-form difference (Jerusha/Jerushah vs Elisha).
